name: Community Action Agency — Jackson Housing Assessment
scope: Housing assessment and coordinated entry for Jackson County
eligibility: Assessment is a starting point; actual assistance depends on eligibility and available resources.
before_you_go: Call ahead, explain your housing situation, and ask what proof to bring.
if_denied: Ask for a coordinated-entry referral, the reason, and another provider serving Jackson County.

name: Michigan Works! Southeast — Jackson
address: 209 E. Washington Avenue, Suite 100, Jackson, MI 49201
scope: Career services, training referrals, job-search help
eligibility: Core job-center assistance available; training funds and specialized programs have their own eligibility rules.
before_you_go: Call to ask which job-search and training services are available, including help without photo ID.
if_denied: Ask which public job-center service is open to you and whether there is another training route.

name: Love INC of Jackson County — Document Assistance
scope: Birth records; replacement ID; some busfare assistance
eligibility: Jackson County residents; eligibility, documentation of need, and availability of funding vary.
before_you_go: Call extension 1. Ask about available vital-document funding or busfare and required proof.
if_denied: Ask for an alternate source of document help; do not assume funding is available.

name: Jackson Area Transportation Authority (JATA)
scope: City bus routes, Reserve-a-Ride and transportation information
eligibility: Routes, coverage, fares, advance-reservation rules and operating hours differ by service.
before_you_go: Call and confirm the bus route, operating time, cost and any advance reservation before making an appointment trip.
if_denied: Ask about Reserve-a-Ride, accessibility service, or a transportation referral.

name: Jackson County Clerk — Birth Records
address: 120 W. Michigan Avenue, 12th Floor, Jackson, MI 49201
scope: Certified Jackson County birth records only
eligibility: This office maintains birth records for people born in Jackson County. Photo ID or an accepted alternative is required; DOC photo ID with recent probation or discharge papers is explicitly listed.
before_you_go: Confirm the record is from Jackson County, the accepted identification, and the current $15 first-copy local counter fee.
if_denied: Ask which accepted alternative ID applies. For another birthplace, use that county or birth-state vital-record office.

name: Legal Services of South Central Michigan — Jackson
scope: Civil legal aid for Jackson and Hillsdale counties
eligibility: Income and matter restrictions apply; not a criminal defense or automatic parole representation service.
before_you_go: Call during posted intake hours and ask whether the specific civil legal issue is eligible.
if_denied: Ask about intake limitations, alternative civil legal aid, or a criminal defense referral for a criminal matter.
